figures.name: Tengri

ability.name: Eternal Blue Sky
ability.description: Grant all Tengrist-aligned cards +3 to all stats; the sky protects the chosen people.

figures.description: The supreme sky deity of the Turkic and Mongolic peoples, the Eternal Blue Sky whose will determines the fate of nations and khans.

figures.name: Umay

ability.name: Mother's Flame
ability.description: Protect all allied child or young hero cards; they gain +3 defense and cannot be sacrificed.

figures.description: The great mother goddess of Turkic tradition, protector of children and women in childbirth, associated with the hearth fire.

figures.name: Erlik

ability.name: Underworld Pull
ability.description: Drag the weakest enemy card to the underworld; they are removed for 3 turns then return weakened.

figures.description: The lord of the underworld in Turkic shamanic tradition, the dark counterpart to Tengri, who rules the dead and tempts the living.

figures.name: Ulgen

ability.name: Creator's Blessing
ability.description: Restore all destroyed allied cards to half stats; the good god reclaims his own.

figures.description: The benevolent sky deity who assists shamans on their upper-world journeys, counterpart to the underworld Erlik, source of light and good.

figures.name: Ayyildiz

ability.name: Star and Crescent
ability.description: Guide all allied cards to safety; nullify all traps for 2 turns.

figures.description: The moon and star, sacred symbols in Turkic cosmology representing celestial guidance, associated with the night sky's protective powers.

figures.name: Dede Korkut

ability.name: Epic Song
ability.description: Recite an epic that boosts all allied card stats by 2 for 3 turns.

figures.description: The legendary shaman-bard and storyteller of the Oghuz Turks, whose Book of Dede Korkut is the foundational epic of Turkic culture.

figures.name: Bozkurt (Grey Wolf)

ability.name: Grey Wolf Ancestor
ability.description: All allied cards trace descent from the wolf; they gain +2 power and cannot flee.

figures.description: The grey wolf, totemic ancestor and guide of the Turkic peoples, who led the ancestral Turks out of danger to a new homeland.

figures.name: Alp Arslan

ability.name: Manzikert Charge
ability.description: Charge at superior numbers; if outnumbered, deal 50% more damage for 2 turns.

figures.description: The great Seljuk sultan whose victory at Manzikert opened Anatolia to the Turks, celebrated as a warrior who trusted in Tengri's will.

figures.name: Koroglu

ability.name: Rebel Rider
ability.description: Ride against all injustice; deal 8 damage to any oppressor-type card.

figures.description: The legendary outlaw hero of Turkic tradition, a rebel who fights against oppression and corruption, celebrated in epic poetry across Central Asia.

figures.name: Gok Tanri (Sky God)

ability.name: Sky Thunder
ability.description: Strike the entire enemy field with lightning; each enemy takes 5 damage.

figures.description: The blue sky god in its thunder aspect, whose lightning bolts smite the unrighteous and announce the will of heaven.

figures.name: Ak Ana

ability.name: White Mother's Word
ability.description: Speak the first word; create one new ability that has never been used this game.

figures.description: The White Mother, primordial spirit who spoke the first words to the creator Tengri, setting creation in motion in Turkic cosmogony.

figures.name: Sahmaran

ability.name: Serpent Wisdom
ability.description: Reveal all healing and poison knowledge; allied cards may use any healing ability for free.

figures.description: The Queen of Serpents, half-woman half-snake, who lives underground and possesses healing knowledge, her body a cure for all poisons.

figures.name: Tepegoz

ability.name: Single Eye
ability.description: See one enemy's weakness; deal 12 damage exploiting that flaw.

figures.description: The one-eyed giant of the Oghuz epics, a cyclops-like monster born of a peri's union with a mortal, whose hide cannot be pierced by arrows.

figures.name: Bamsi Beyrek

ability.name: Undying Loyalty
ability.description: Return from any captivity or defeat; restore to 80% stats after being destroyed once.

figures.description: The hero Bamsi Beyrek of the Book of Dede Korkut, captured by enemies but freed by his faithful betrothed after 16 years.

figures.name: Oghuz Khagan

ability.name: Empire Founding
ability.description: Establish dominance; all allied Turkic cards gain +3 to all stats permanently.

figures.description: The legendary founding ancestor-hero of the Oghuz Turks, who conquered vast territories and established the great Oghuz confederation.

figures.name: Kirkpinar Pehlivan

ability.name: Oil Wrestling
ability.description: Grapple one enemy; they cannot use any ability for 2 turns while held.

figures.description: The legendary oil wrestler hero of Turkic tradition, whose contests of strength and honor are preserved in the ancient Kirkpinar festival.

figures.name: Alkarisi

ability.name: Childbirth Terror
ability.description: Curse one allied card to be weakened at their most critical moment.

figures.description: The Turkic nightmare demon who attacks women in childbirth and causes infant illness, one of the most feared spirits of folk belief.

figures.name: Hizir

ability.name: Green Man's Help
ability.description: Appear to the most desperate ally; instantly resolve their crisis with +5 to the needed stat.

figures.description: The immortal green man who appears to help the desperate and lost, associated with Khidr in Islamic synthesis, Turkic culture's most benevolent wandering spirit.

figures.name: Suleyman Shah

ability.name: River Crossing
ability.description: Cross any barrier; allied cards can enter any zone regardless of terrain restrictions.

figures.description: The grandfather of Osman I who drowned crossing the Euphrates, his tomb maintained as Turkish sovereign territory, founding ancestor of Ottoman glory.

figures.name: Asena

ability.name: Wolf Mother
ability.description: Nurture the weakest allied card to full strength; it gains wolf totem +2 all stats.

figures.description: The she-wolf who nursed the ancestral Turk from whom the ruling clan descended, the nurturing aspect of the wolf totem.
